title: Integrate abstract interpretation

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 bounded abstract interpretation for the exact current admitted datasets source forest
scope.implementation_delta: The exact current-head datasets forest already contains the smallest versioned Python-v1 abstract-interpreter authority: immutable product lattices, a deterministic bounded worklist with widening/narrowing, a conservative Python adapter, content-addressed source/config/result identities, explicit opaque frontiers, candidate-tier contracts, and an existing verification API adapter. This receipt selects and binds that authority. It adds neither a proof_context wrapper nor a second interpreter, source-map authority, proof authority, or M2/M3 mutation path.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The required proof_context suite has same-nested-tree provider evidence, but the authoritative sealed Python 3.12 attempt aborts before collection because the explicitly configured anyio pytest plugin is absent. The analysis also intentionally emits candidate-tier semantic evidence, not kernel-checked proof evidence. Neither sealed validation nor proof promotion is claimed.

evidence_legend.unavailable: A required identity, capability, or result absent from the authoritative environment; it is neither zero nor passing.

freshness_check.method: git rev-parse HEAD and HEAD^{tree}; git ls-tree HEAD for the datasets gitlink; git -C external/ipfs_datasets rev-parse HEAD and HEAD^{tree}; git status --porcelain=v1 for outer and datasets roots before receipt write; git -C external/ipfs_datasets merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD; SHA-256 and git-blob inspection of every named source/test authority.
freshness_check.result: The superproject gitlink equals the measured datasets HEAD. Both roots were clean before receipt write, and configured datasets origin/main is an ancestor of the measured datasets head.
freshness_check.invalidates_on: Any changed outer commit/tree, datasets gitlink/head/tree, scheduler digest, named source digest, schema/version, CID profile, test input, or validation-environment capability requires a fresh receipt.

pcsm_source_map.reason: No emitted PCSM current-tree SourceLinkReceipt or canonical aggregate source-map CID exists. Git/tree/blob and per-source canonical identities are not substituted for that missing PCSM artifact.

semantic_contract: The immutable product domain combines flat canonical scalar constants, integer intervals, nullness, possible exceptions, and effects; joins, meets, widening, and narrowing are explicit operations.

solve_worklist_fixpoint uses a deterministic queue and sorted state representation, applies widening per destination after a configured threshold, and performs bounded narrowing only after convergence.
AnalysisConfig version-binds max iterations, widening/narrowing budgets, path/context sensitivity, and call-string limit into the analyzer identity.

PythonAbstractInterpreter parses source without importing or executing it, records source coordinates, summarizes only local functions interprocedurally, and binds source URI/text, analyzer configuration, summaries, support class, and limitations into CIDs.
Reflection, dynamic code/module loading, native extensions, uncontrolled I/O, and opaque callbacks become explicit opaque state/reasons rather than an exact semantic claim.
AbstractContractCandidate is expressly candidate-tier; an independently admitted consumer must compile and discharge it before treating it as contract or proof evidence.

deterministic_replay.method: Two fresh Python 3.12 provider processes with PYTHONHASHSEED=1 and PYTHONHASHSEED=777 analyzed identical source and source_uri.
deterministic_replay.limitation: Provider replay is simulated evidence and does not replace a sealed-environment deterministic test.

selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: Reimplementation under proof_context would duplicate a current canonical authority and violate the exact receipt-only output boundary. Existing dedicated unit coverage and the public adapter provide the required integration selection without a competing subsystem.

positive_coverage: five abstract component domains satisfy ordering, join, meet, and idempotence laws
product joins are sound upper bounds; interval widening converges and bounded narrowing recovers a finite bound

a bounded cyclic worklist converges with a widened node; unreachable points, exceptional flow, conditionally unbound locals, local-call summaries, context policy, and a loop invariant are retained conservatively

identity tests reject equivalence of changed source or changed analyzer configuration

negative_coverage: empty source is rejected by the checked public adapter rather than being analyzed as a valid program

limitations: This task is receipt-only: it selects existing current-head abstract interpretation and public-adapter coverage and does not mutate proof_context or create a competing interpreter.

The selected authority is a bounded, conservative static analysis of a Python subset. It does not establish whole-CPython runtime semantics, aliases, descriptors, metaclasses, native extensions, dynamic code/module loading, opaque callbacks, generated-code correctness, or PCSM source linking.
Widening, iteration, sensitivity, and call-string budgets deliberately bound precision and may produce conservative or opaque outcomes; candidate contracts require independent downstream discharge.
The authoritative sealed suite remains unavailable because anyio is absent, so this receipt cannot promote completion despite provider-side positive evidence.
The receipt's own canonical storage CID is unavailable because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.

rollback.procedure: Revert only this receipt and invalidate consumers of this PCSM abstract-analysis selection. Do not alter the selected datasets source forest, protected policy documents, or prior admitted history.
rollback.freshness_requirement: Do not reuse this receipt after any bound tree, gitlink, source digest, scheduler binding, schema/version, CID profile, analyzer configuration, test input, or validation-environment capability changes.
